opspec.formula: o[b,h,m,:] = softmax_n(q[b,h,m,:] . k[b,h,n,:] * (SM_SCALE + LOG2E)) v[b,h,n,:] where LOG2E = log2(e) (the specification forms the qk scale as a sum, not the usual product); online softmax, fp32 statistics/accumulator, one rounding

SM_SCALE.doc: softmax scale 1/sqrt(D) (D = 64 in every declared size)
